### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker
* **Failing Jobs**: Script Tests on PR #25 (epic 3e74-56da)
* **Two independent failures**:

**Failure A — test-ticket-perf.sh**: `TICKET_ID` capture uses `| tr -d '[:space:]'` which strips all whitespace including newlines. After dual-output `ticket create` emits two stdout lines (`Created ticket <id>: <title>` then `<id>`), `tr -d '[:space:]'` collapses both into `Createdticket<id>:<title><id>`. This broken ID is passed to `ticket show`, which fails with exit 1, causing hyperfine to report an error.

**Failure B — test-ticket-create.sh Test 21**: The CREATE event `data` object is missing a `data.id` field. Test 21 asserts `data.get('id') or data.get('ticket_id')` equals the 16-hex canonical ID. The implementation in ticket-create.sh builds the `data` dict with ticket_type, title, parent_id, description, tags, priority, assignee, alias — but never includes `id`. The `.test-index` has no RED marker for `test_16hex_event_data_id`, meaning this test was expected to pass after the 16-hex implementation.
data.title: [Script Tests CI]: dual-output ticket create breaks perf test + data.id missing from CREATE event
